author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
1. Google Cogdog flickr cc attribution tool
  2. make sure you can see the bookmarks bar in your Browser
  3. Use Chrome, does not work in Firefox or Safari.
  4. Set the settings and drag bookmarklet to bookmark bar
  5. Go to flickr
  6. Search Flickr
  7. When you get your results selct the drop down "any license" selce any "creative commons"
  8. You hit bookmarklet on photo
  9. Choose htmt>image. just html attribution, just text attribution, or download.
